title: GitHub CI as a release build before the release: a rehearsal input and a weekly run
author: Claude-JG
description: the rehearsal on a release/* branch (docs/dev/RELEASE.md) builds as a release only from the commit after 'exudev issue mode --release'; a dev version builds exudynCPPfast for cp313 only, so the Linux ARM failure of 1.13 (#2918) shows there for one version. A workflow_dispatch input that builds the fast module for every version (setup.py reads EXUDYN_COMPILE_EXUDYN_FAST, but the dev rule overrides it), and a weekly scheduled run on a release/* branch to catch changes on the GitHub side (runner image, Python patch release, numpy)
